summary: Etherpad plugin registers unauthenticated host-recon endpoint
details: The package registers itself as an Etherpad plugin and, via the expressPreSession hook, adds an unauthenticated GET route /Nx_50049/ to the host Etherpad server. Any remote caller who can reach the Etherpad instance receives a JSON response containing os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.platform, Node.js version, process.cwd(), and process.pid, along with a 'Nxploited | Nx-zD' banner. The endpoint is not documented, provides no legitimate Etherpad functionality, and exposes host-identity information to arbitrary unauthenticated remote callers as a direct consequence of loading the plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
